title: Playboy June 1964 | Playmate Lori Winston, Mamie Van Doren, 1958 Playmates
descriptionText: The product is a vintage issue of Playboy magazine from June 1964. It features Playmate Lori Winston, Mamie Van Doren, and 1958 Playmates in a pictorial titled "1958 Playmates Revisited." The magazine includes content by Ian Fleming, Frederik Pohl, Prentiss Combs, and an interview with Ingmar Bergman. The cover showcases Mamie Van Doren with the Playboy Rabbit, and the issue contains 186 pages of photography, music, modeling, and fiction. With a circulation of 2,426,654, this collectible magazine from HMH Publishing offers a glimpse into the popular culture of the early 1960s.
